newsitem.title: SWEDEN: S&P revises Stena outlook to stable from positive.
newsitem.headline: S&P revises Stena outlook to stable from positive.

text.p: U.S. credit rating agency Standard & Poor's on Thursday said it had revised its outlook for Stena AB to stable from positive because of higher leverage and ferry operating unit Stena Line's weak position.

"The stable outlook reflects the company's strong position in the Roll-on/Roll-off (RoRo) and ferry market, a diversified product portfolio and its geographic diversification," S&P said in a statement.
"However it is anticpated that Stena's leverage will not deteriorate much beyond the current level."
S&P said it was not changing Stena AB's ratings which currently stand at BB for issuer credit and BB- for senior unsecured debt.
Stena AB, a Swedish family owned company, is mainly involved in shipping, oil drilling and real estate.

"The ratings are held back by Stena's exposure to the volatile oil tanker and oil drilling sectors, a high leverage and a weak financial profile in Stena Line AB, the world's largest ferry shipping company," S&P said.
